name: json (recp/json)
reason: README (28 stars, MIT; directories docs, fuzz, include/json, src, win; no benchmark directory) makes only qualitative claims: it 'does not alloc any memory for JSON itself, it only allocs memory for tokens', 'does not use recursive way to build data structure which makes it very fast', and calls the objmap API 'VERY FAST'. No numbers and no named baseline anywhere in the README; its own TODO list leaves 'extra optimizations' and 'tests' unchecked. Not in miloyip/nativejson-benchmark (library list and sample performance CSV have no row for it) or in stephenberry/json_performance. A web search for recp/json against Jansson, cJSON or parson returned no timing of it.

name: JSON Toolkit (sourcemeta/jsontoolkit, now sourcemeta/core)
listed_description: JSON, JSON Pointer, JSON Schema, and JSONL library for C++20.
reason: The repository was renamed to sourcemeta/core (53 stars; LICENSE is AGPL-3.0-or-later or commercial dual licence); its README.markdown only links to documentation (core.sourcemeta.com, blocked from this environment) and a coverage report. Its benchmark/ directory (json.cc, jsonl.cc, jsonpointer.cc, jsonschema.cc, regex.cc, etc.) holds self-contained microbenchmarks of its own API; the json.cc, jsonl.cc and jsonschema.cc sources and the CMakeLists contain no reference to nlohmann, RapidJSON, simdjson or yyjson, and no results are published in the repo. Not in miloyip/nativejson-benchmark or stephenberry/json_performance. The only third-party-style numbers in the project family are for Blaze (sourcemeta/blaze, a separate repo that took over the JSON Schema evaluator; paper 'Blaze: Compiling JSON Schema for 10x Faster Validation', arXiv 2503.02770, compares JSON Schema validators), which is a different project from this entry.

name: json-build
reason: Repo page (52 stars, MIT; files test/, LICENSE, README.md, json-build.h) and README claim only C89 compatibility, no dependencies and no dynamic memory allocation; no timing numbers, no benchmark directory, no named baseline. Not in miloyip/nativejson-benchmark (which has no row for it) or stephenberry/json_performance. A web search for json-build benchmarks returned only directory pages repeating the README feature list.
